title.zh: Microsoft and Coinbase probe leads to arrest of crooks behind 'EvilTokens', a DIY phishing network powered by AI - fortune.com
title.en: Microsoft and Coinbase probe leads to arrest of crooks behind 'EvilTokens', a DIY phishing network powered by AI - fortune.com

current_state.zh: EvilTokens 基础设施已被拆除，相关域名和网站被查获/关停；Coinbase 已追踪约 110 万美元平台收入；两名嫌疑人被捕后获有条件保释；微软警告同类认证滥用和 AI 辅助欺诈模式仍可能被复用。
current_state.en: EvilTokens infrastructure has been dismantled, with related websites and domains seized/disabled; Coinbase traced about $1.1 million in platform revenue; two suspects were arrested and released on conditional bail; Microsoft warned the same authentication abuse and AI-assisted fraud model can still be reused.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase traced $1.1 million crypto trail behind AI phishing service EvilTokens
updates.title_en: Coinbase traced $1.1 million crypto trail behind AI phishing service EvilTokens
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增事实：Coinbase 追踪到 EvilTokens 约 110 万美元平台收入，流向四个 Tron 地址（2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 6 月）；该钓鱼服务入侵超过 12,000 个邮箱、涉及 10,000 多个组织；执法方查获 50 个网站并关停 150 多个相关域名；英国警方于 9 月 11 日逮捕两名嫌疑人，后获有条件保释。
updates.what_changed_en: New facts: Coinbase traced about $1.1 million in EvilTokens platform revenue across four Tron addresses from October 2025 to June 2026; the phishing service compromised over 12,000 inboxes across more than 10,000 organizations; authorities seized 50 websites and disabled over 150 related domains; UK police arrested two suspects on Sept. 11, later released on conditional bail.
updates.current_state_zh: EvilTokens 基础设施已被拆除，相关域名和网站被查获/关停；Coinbase 已追踪约 110 万美元平台收入；两名嫌疑人被捕后获有条件保释；微软警告同类认证滥用和 AI 辅助欺诈模式仍可能被复用。
updates.current_state_en: EvilTokens infrastructure has been dismantled, with related websites and domains seized/disabled; Coinbase traced about $1.1 million in platform revenue; two suspects were arrested and released on conditional bail; Microsoft warned the same authentication abuse and AI-assisted fraud model can still be reused.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Microsoft and Coinbase helped dismantle EvilTokens, an AI-assisted phishing service that abused Microsoft's device-code login flow to compromise more than 12,000 inboxes across 10,000 organizations, tracing a $1.1 million crypto trail and seizing 50 websites plus 150 related domains.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft and Coinbase helped dismantle EvilTokens, an AI-assisted phishing service that abused Microsoft's device-code login flow to compromise more than 12,000 inboxes across 10,000 organizations, tracing a $1.1 million crypto trail and seizing 50 websites plus 150 related domains.
